chunks: And from his sayings (peace be upon him) regarding the teaching of war and fighting, in some of the days of Siffin.

key_terms.الْمُقَاتَلَةِ: Fighting, combat, or the act of engaging in battle.
key_terms.صِفِّينَ: Siffin, a location in Syria where the Battle of Siffin took place between Imam Ali and Muawiyah.

ai.seo_question: What are the military teachings of Imam Ali during the Battle of Siffin?
ai.summary: This heading introduces Imam Ali’s (AS) strategic discourse during the pivotal Battle of Siffin (657 CE), a period marked by the arbitration dispute that tested the Caliphate's unity. It highlights the practical application of his leadership, offering insights into military ethics and tactical command that are central to Shia political and military thought.
